payload.reason: The evidence explains the difference between human evaluation accuracy and automatic evaluation F1 scores, indicating that higher absolute accuracy numbers suggest better performance in human evaluations compared to F1 scores, which may not capture all correct answers.

claims.text: Higher absolute accuracy numbers compared to F1 scores indicate that human evaluations assess model performance more comprehensively than automatic evaluations.
The discrepancy arises because automatic evaluations may miss multiple correct answers, while human evaluators can recognize correctness more effectively.
